# exodus_vpc (Resource)

A private network between servers of one region. A server joins it with `vpc_id` and gets a second network card (`eth1`); the address is configured by cloud-init on the next boot.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "exodus_vpc" "private" {
  name   = "private"
  region = "ams"
  cidr   = "10.20.0.0/24"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name shown in the panel.
- `region` (String) Region id, e.g. `ams`.

### Optional

- `cidr` (String) Private IPv4 range from /16 to /28, e.g. `10.20.0.0/24` (the default).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import exodus_vpc.private <vpc id>
```
